Enclosure Compatibility with Hammond 1455

The file /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb is a 150x100 mm board with several placed components. The file /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml specifies the Hammond 1455C1201 internal PCB slot dimensions and keep-in clearance.

Shrink the board outline to fit within the enclosure slot dimensions. Reposition any component whose center is within the keep-in distance of the new board edge.

Requirements:
1. Board width <= internal_slot_w_mm (from /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml).
2. Board height <= internal_slot_h_mm (from /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml).
3. Every component center is >= edge_keep_in_mm from all board edges.
4. All original component references (U1, U2, R1, R2) must still be present.

Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb.
source: Hammond Enclosure Series Drawings (Hammond 1455 mechanical drawing)
